item.description:
New

  • Respond with Allow Once or Deny to single permission requests from your paired iPhone while your Mac is locked, asleep, or idle for 5 minutes, over a local direct connection or encrypted relay; turn on Approve on iPhone when away under Settings › iPhone Link (off by default, with unhandled or timed-out requests falling back to your Mac terminal).

Fixed

  • Fix the Dynamic Island attention glow and Increase Contrast border drawing a static rectangular top edge beside the notch, so the outline hugs the outer notch contour again.
  • Fix new Dynamic Island activity jumping or shifting the left wing when switching or expanding; activity rows now unfold downward from the top and stop animating immediately when Reduce Motion or Low Power Mode turns on.
  • Fix English wording in Settings, Usage, and Membership restore messages, including showing vendor quota percentages in natural English order and clarifying expired sign-in and account-mismatch errors.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
  • Phone Approval requires MeloraPhone 1.1.0 on iPhone paired by QR code.
